description: This Java class 'HttpUrl' serves as a wrapper around the standard java.net.URL class, providing an abstraction layer for HTTP URL handling. Its main purpose is to facilitate mocking of HTTP calls in testing environments by encapsulating URL instantiation and connection opening.

classes.name: HttpUrl
classes.description: A wrapper class for java.net.URL to allow easier mocking and validation of HTTP URLs.

methods.name: HttpUrl
methods.description: Constructor that validates and initializes the URL object from a string.

methods.description: Returns an HttpURLConnection object for the encapsulated URL.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the URL.
